description: This file contains unit tests for EventHub subscription observer behavior with implicit subscriptions across multiple stream providers in an Orleans-based system. It defines a test class with a fixture that configures a test cluster with EventHub stream providers, and specific configurations for stream pub/sub and checkpointers. The tests verify streaming behavior with implicit subscriptions utilizing Azure EventHub and Azure Table Storage components.
